analysis_unit: one user-selected complete Site1/Site2 bundle trajectory

layout.left: large complete-cell Site1/Site2/53BP1 pseudocolor with both tracks
layout.upper_middle: separate Site1 and Site2 pixel panels with identical crop bounds
layout.lower_middle: median-centered X and Y traces in Site1 yellow and Site2 purple
layout.right: joint physical trajectory; site-color halo plus shared jet acquisition-time color

green_channel_role: visual nuclear context only; never selection, filter or outcome
site_pixel_coordinate_contract: same production pixel frame, same CropBounds and same scale

physical_trajectory.origin: joint Site1/Site2 minimum x/y shifted to 50 nm, matching source MATLAB
physical_trajectory.y_direction: production y_nm direction, matching source MATLAB
physical_trajectory.axis_scale_scope: equal x/y aspect within each case; case-specific range
physical_trajectory.site_identity: yellow/purple halo and circle/square endpoint symbols
physical_trajectory.colorbar: exact relative acquisition time in seconds at five MATLAB-style ticks

xy_traces.shared_scale_scope: identical for X and Y panels across both poster demo cases
